column2: 价值购买商品。其他货币可以当作普通物品交易，对方也可能用当地货币找零。这样便能

column1: In order to receive recognition for your accomplishments, you must tell the relevant people about them. The quest giver is a safe bet,
column2: 要让功绩得到认可，必须向相关的人讲述你的事迹。告诉任务发布者最稳妥，

column1: especially if it's a hearth order, but generally you can tell anybody in a group what you've done and they'll react and spread the news. Most villages
column2: 亲卫命令尤其如此。不过通常也可以告诉群体中的任何人，他们会作出反应并传播消息。例如，不论是否由当地人委托，

column1: will be happy that you've slain a dragon, for instance, whether you've received the quest from them or not, and it might be worth

column2: 可能在保留昔日宝藏的同时，迎来了新的住客……

column2: 冒险不一定非要以战死或饿死结束。身处友善的聚居地时，你可以在那里退役。

column1: Retired adventurers will continue their travels, and might show up in a future fortress or be hired by a future adventuring party.

column1: You can also unretire characters directly if they are still alive.
column2: 只要角色还活着，也可以直接让其结束退役，重返冒险。

column1: Before you begin your travels, we'll familiarize you with the basic controls.
column2: 出发旅行之前，先来熟悉基本操作。

column1: Your view is focused on one elevation at a time. To move the camera around, hold the middle mouse button and drag the view.

column1: When your view is in the air above other tiles, you can usually see them below. If you are indoors or in a cavern, your view might be blocked by the ceiling.
column2: 视角位于其他地块上方的空中时，通常可以看到下方。如果身处室内或洞穴，顶层可能挡住视线。

column1: The view is dark underground. You can recenter on yourself with the

column1: Every creature in adventure mode moves simultaneously. Once you initiate movement, play will advance until you can move again. The duration of movement depends on gait, injuries, etc.
column2: 冒险模式中的所有生物同时行动。一旦开始移动，游戏就会推进，直到你能再次行动。移动耗时取决于步态、伤势等因素。

column1: The easiest way to move is to left click in the play area. Your character will path to the target tile if possible.
column2: 最简单的移动方式是左键点击游戏区域。只要路径可达，角色就会前往目标地块。

column1: If you right click in the play area, you'll open a context-sensitive menu of actions. This lets you select a destination more carefully.
column2: 右键点击游戏区域，会打开符合当前情境的操作菜单，便于更谨慎地选择目的地。

column1: It's very important to note that only one creature can be standing in a tile at a time.
column2: 请牢记，同一时间每格只能有一个生物站立。

column1: If you see brown downward triangles under your character, you will move very slowly and should try to stand if you are able.
column2: 如果角色下方出现棕色倒三角，移动速度就会很慢；只要能够站起，就应该尝试起身。

column1: You can alternate between standing and a prone position by clicking the indicated button or pressing
column2: 点击图示按钮，或按相应热键，即可在站立和俯卧之间切换：

column1: You can set your gait/speed and other movement options by clicking the indicated button or pressing
column2: 点击图示按钮，或按相应热键，可设置步态、速度及其他移动选项：

column1: . This menu will also show you how stealthfully you are moving.
column2: 。该菜单也会显示你目前的潜行程度。

column1: If you have a number pad, you can move one tile at a time by pressing
column2: 如果有数字小键盘，可以逐格移动，按

column1: etc. If you want to move carefully, confirming your selection, you can press
column2: 等方向键即可。若想谨慎移动，在行动前确认目标，可以按

column1: You can also flying to other altitudes by left/right clicking while the camera is adjusted.
column2: 调整视角高度后，也可以左键或右键点击，飞往其他高度层。

column1: You can click the indicated button or press
column2: 你可以点击图示按钮，或按

column1: to view your character's status. This can be used to view your injuries, skills and needs.
column2: 查看角色状态，包括伤势、技能和需求。

column1: to view your log. Your character generally starts with a variety of local knowledge, including a few places to have an adventure.
column2: 查看日志。角色通常一开始就掌握不少本地知识，其中包括一些适合冒险的地点。

column1: You can also speak to locals and inquire about their troubles.
column2: 你也可以与当地人交谈，询问他们的烦恼。

column1: to view and interact with your worn and carried items.
column2: 查看并操作身上穿戴或携带的物品。

column1: to interact with nearby objects and environmental features. In particular, this is an easy way to pick things up.
column2: 与附近物体和环境设施交互。这也是拾取物品的便捷方式。

column1: Right click on people to initiate conversations. You can click the indicated button or press
column2: 右键点击人物可开始交谈。点击图示按钮，或按

column1: to continue an active conversation. People can share troubles they'd like your help with, and you can also trade with shopkeepers or barter with most others.
column2: 继续当前对话。人们会讲述希望你帮助解决的烦恼；你也可以与店主交易，或与大多数其他人以物易物。

column1: Conversations, like movement, take place over time. If you engage in a conversation, you'll generally wait for a reply before you can act again.
column2: 与移动一样，交谈也会消耗时间。开始交谈后，通常要等到对方回复才能再次行动。

column1: to butcher a carcass or to engage in crafting activities. Hunting is an important way to get food. The base game has limited crafting.
column2: 屠宰尸体或进行制作。狩猎是重要的食物来源，原版游戏的制作内容则较为有限。

column1: You can strike, wrestle, or shoot to engage in combat. You can also throw objects in your inventory.
column2: 可以通过打击、摔跤或射击战斗，也可以投掷物品栏中的物品。

column1: Moving toward an active opponent will initiate a default attack, or you can use the strike and wrestle buttons (or right click Combat option) to
column2: 向正在交战的敌人移动，会发起默认攻击。也可以使用打击、摔跤按钮，或右键菜单中的战斗选项，

column1: specify your attack more precisly.
column2: 更精确地指定攻击方式。

column1: to yield in combat. If the conflict has not reached a No Quarter state, your opponent should stand down.
column2: 在战斗中投降。只要冲突尚未进入“不留活口”状态，对手通常就会停止攻击。

column1: You can also demand your opponent yield using a conversation option.
column2: 你也可以通过交谈选项，要求对方投降。

column1: to draw or strap your weapon. If your weapons are drawn and you aren't a local soldier, people may panic.
column2: 拔出或收起武器。如果你并非当地士兵，亮出武器可能引起恐慌。

column1: If you miss an announcement or would like to review old messages, you can click the indicated button or press
column2: 若错过公告或想回看之前的消息，可以点击图示按钮，或按

column1: Here you'll see a list of party members, companions, and pets, along with their general location if you know it.
column2: 这里会列出队员、同伴和宠物，以及你所知的他们的大致位置。

column1: You can assume control of party members. Companions who join you later in the journey can't generally be controlled manually.
column2: 你可以接管队伍成员。旅途中后来加入的同伴通常不能手动控制。

column1: You can also set whether a party member will be controlled manually during tactical mode, or whether they'll be controlled by the computer.
column2: 你还可以设置，在战术模式中由自己手动控制某位队员，还是交由电脑控制。

column1: In tactical mode, you can control every party member manually if you wish, allow you to coordinate movements and attack with more precision.
column2: 在战术模式中，只要愿意，就可以手动控制每位队员，更精确地协调移动和攻击。

column1: Tactical mode can be set by a button near the companion mode button on the main menu if you have multiple party members.
column2: 如果有多位队员，可以通过主菜单中同伴模式按钮附近的按钮设置战术模式。

column1: This is your adventurer's log. It functions as an encyclopedia of your known world, and also keeps track of important agreements, such as quests.
column2: 这是冒险者日志，既是已知世界的百科全书，也会记录任务等重要约定。

column1: In the beginning, you'll probably find it populated with a variety of rumors and knowledge known to everybody from your home. This could include some opportunities for adventure.
column2: 刚开始时，日志通常已有家乡人尽皆知的各种传闻和知识，其中可能藏着冒险机会。

column1: Here you can interact with the objects you are carrying. Items can be dropped, worn, eaten, thrown, named, etc. The icon tooltips describe your options for each item.
column2: 这里可以操作携带的物品，例如丢弃、穿戴、食用、投掷和命名。每件物品旁图标的悬停提示会说明可用操作。

column1: Inventory items are all worn, held, in containers, or otherwise related to specific body parts. There is no abstract inventory space.
column2: 物品栏中的物品都实际穿戴、拿持、装在容器中，或以其他方式与身体部位相连，并不存在抽象的物品栏空间。

column1: If you are carrying too much, you'll see an encumbrance indicator above the inventory button. Encumbrance can cause you to move very slowly and should be avoided if possible.
column2: 携带过多物品时，物品栏按钮上方会出现负重提示。过重会让移动极其缓慢，应尽量避免。

column1: This is the movement options menu. Here you can choose your gait and see your current stealth profile.
column2: 这是移动选项菜单。在这里可以选择步态，并查看当前的潜行状况。

column1: Moving quickly costs energy. You'll begin to move slowly or even collapse if you sprint for too long.
column2: 快速移动会消耗体力。冲刺太久，就会开始减速，甚至倒下。

column1: If a gait has two numbers, the first number is the starting speed for the gait, and the second is the maximum speed.
column2: 如果一种步态显示两个数值，第一个是起始速度，第二个是最高速度。

column1: Continue moving in the same direction to build up speed. If you or your mount are moving quickly, your attacks gain velocity.
column2: 持续朝同一方向移动可以加速。你或坐骑高速移动时，攻击也会获得额外速度。

column1: This is the hold and climb menu.
column2: 这是抓握与攀爬菜单。

column1: You can climb trees. First you must establish a hold with a free grasp. Then you can continue to move up into the air, while maintaining a hold on an adjacent tile.
column2: 你可以爬树。先用空闲的抓握部位抓住支点，然后在保持抓住相邻地块的同时，继续向上移动。

column1: If you climb atop certain large branches, you can walk on them freely.
column2: 爬到某些粗大的树枝上后，就可以自由行走。

column1: Some surfaces like walls can be also climbed, but these require climbing skill to hold reliably.
column2: 墙壁等某些表面也能攀爬，但需要攀爬技能才能稳稳抓住。

column1: You can jump while climbing, and you can also release your hold. In these ways, you might reach areas you can't otherwise reach.
column2: 攀爬时可以跳跃，也可以松手。借助这些动作，你或许能到达其他方式无法到达的地方。

column1: The hold menu also allows you to lead and mount pets. You can claim stray animals as pets here too. To name your new pets, use the talk menu.
column2: 抓握菜单也可以牵引和骑乘宠物，还能将无主动物收为宠物。要为新宠物命名，请使用交谈菜单。

column1: This is the conversation menu.
column2: 这是交谈菜单。

column1: Conversations occur over time, like movements and attacks.
column2: 与移动和攻击一样，交谈也需要时间。

column1: When speaking to somebody, you'll choose what to say, and then time will pass while you are speaking and waiting for a reply.
column2: 与人交谈时，你先选择说什么，然后在说话和等待回复的过程中，时间会继续推进。

column1: There are many conversation options. Important ones to note at first are inquiring about troubles, which might set you on the road to adventure,
column2: 交谈选项有很多。刚开始尤其值得留意的是询问烦恼，这可能让你踏上冒险之路，

column1: asking for duties from your leader if you have one, and the ability to trade in shops. You can also ask anybody to join you, but many people will be shy of danger.
column2: 向首领领取职责，以及在商店交易。你也可以邀请任何人同行，但很多人会畏惧危险。

column1: This is the performance menu. Here you can initiate a poetry recital, tell a story, dance, sing, or play a musical instrument.
column2: 这是表演菜单。可以朗诵诗歌、讲故事、跳舞、唱歌或演奏乐器。

column1: You can also compose poems, songs, and choreography if you know a relevant art form.
column2: 如果掌握了相关艺术形式，还可以创作诗歌、歌曲或舞蹈编排。

column1: Performance occur over a period of time related to the specific art form or piece. You can interrupt the performance as it unfolds, commit to finishing it and wait for its completion, or continue in steps.
column2: 表演持续时间取决于具体艺术形式或作品。表演中可以中断、决定一直表演完并等待结束，也可以分步推进。

column1: Compositions take more time, and you'll pass through a period of time similar to sleeping, resting, and traveling.
column2: 创作耗时更长，会像睡眠、休息和旅行一样，让一段时间连续流逝。

column1: This is the butchering and crafting menu.
column2: 这是屠宰与制作菜单。

column1: Butchering requires a sharp-edged weapon or tool, as well as a butcherable carcass. Butchering is an excellent source of meat. The other products cannot currently be used.
column2: 屠宰需要有刃口的武器或工具，以及可以屠宰的尸体。屠宰是很好的肉食来源，但其他产物目前还无法使用。

column1: Crafting in the base game is limited to constructing a stone axe necessary to fell trees. You can pick up few rocks and a tree branch to get started.
column2: 原版游戏的制作仅限于打造伐木所需的石斧。捡几块石头和一根树枝，就可以开始。

column1: Any ability you possess that doesn't fit elsewhere will appear here. For instance, many creatures can spit or pet animals. Others can breathe fire.
column2: 你拥有但不属于其他分类的能力会显示在这里。例如，许多生物可以唾液或抚摸动物，有些还能喷火。

column1: Some abilities, like the flight of winged creatures, can just be used during regular movement without needing this menu.
column2: 某些能力，例如有翼生物的飞行，可以直接在普通移动时使用，无需打开这个菜单。

column1: If you obtain any magical powers during your adventure, you will find them in this menu.
column2: 如果在冒险中获得魔法力量，也会在此菜单中找到。

column1: This is the attack menu. Here you can strike creatures with an item or body part, or you can initiate a dodge or parry movement.
column2: 这是攻击菜单。可以用物品或身体部位打击生物，也可以发起闪避或招架动作。

column1: Attacks target specific body parts and have various modifiers. You will select these in the subsequent menus.
column2: 攻击针对具体身体部位，并带有各种修正项。接下来的菜单会让你选择这些内容。

column1: There is a random element to outcomes and some body parts will be easier or harder to hit from moment to moment.
column2: 结果包含随机因素，各身体部位在不同时刻的命中难度也会变化。

column1: However, skill is the most important determiner of hits versus misses.
column2: 不过，技能是决定命中与否的最重要因素。

column1: Once a strike hits, the materials and velocity are used to determine the damage.
column2: 打击命中后，会根据材料和速度计算伤害。

column1: Skill and item quality can help with this, but sometimes it's just not possible to damage a target material with a weaker material.
column2: 技能和物品品质会有帮助，但较弱的材料有时就是无法损伤更坚硬的目标材料。

column1: For this reason, it's important to obtain better equipment when you can.
column2: 因此，只要有机会，就应设法获得更好的装备。

column1: This is the wrestling menu. Here you can grab creatures and then execute a variety of wrestling moves. You can also initiate defensive actions here.
column2: 这是摔跤菜单。可以抓住生物，再施展各种摔跤动作，也可以在这里采取防御行动。

column1: Wrestling involves specific attacking body parts and specific target body parts.
column2: 摔跤涉及具体的攻击身体部位和目标身体部位。

column1: You can grab creatures with your grasps and limbs, and both the target and attacking part determine which wrestling moves are available.
column2: 可以用抓握部位和肢体抓住生物。能使用哪些摔跤动作，由攻击部位和目标部位共同决定。

column1: Relative body size is the most important determiner of wrestling outcomes. A character's wrestling skill is also important.
column2: 双方体型差距是摔跤结果最重要的决定因素，角色的摔跤技能也很重要。

column1: Unless you are very skilled, you should not attempt to wrestle larger creatures, and you should try to avoid being grabbed by them.
column2: 除非十分熟练，否则不要尝试与更大的生物摔跤，也应尽量避免被它们抓住。

column1: This is the projectile aiming menu. You can shoot projectiles with a launcher like a bow or crossbow, and you can throw almost any object that you are carrying in a grasp.
column2: 这是远程瞄准菜单。可以用弓、弩等发射器射击，也可以投掷手中拿着的几乎任何物品。

column1: You can initiate throwing from the inventory menu, or by pressing
column2: 可以从物品栏菜单发起投掷，也可以按

column1: Be warned that shooting a projectile currently has a long recovery time, so you may be subject to attack after you fire.
column2: 请注意，目前发射弹药后的恢复时间较长，因此射击后可能遭到攻击。

column1: Friendly fire isn't currently possible, so your companions should be safe.
column2: 目前不会误伤友军，因此同伴应该是安全的。

column1: Here you can travel great distances without having to move in the local mode. You still become thirsty, hungry, and drowsy while traveling.
column2: 这里可以长途旅行，不必在本地模式中逐步移动。旅行时仍会口渴、饥饿和困倦。

column1: You are also still subject to attack or ambush, though you can see certain groups on the map and may be able to avoid them.
column2: 旅行中仍可能遭到攻击或伏击，不过你能在地图上看到某些队伍，也许可以绕开。

column1: You can stop traveling using the stop travel button below or by pressing .
column2: 点击下方的停止旅行按钮，或按相应热键，即可停止旅行。

column1: This is the sleep menu. Here you can sleep to overcome drowsiness or wait to pass time.
column2: 这是睡眠菜单。可以睡觉消除困倦，也可以等待以打发时间。

column1: If you have multiple party members, your chances of being ambushed will be greatly reduced.
column2: 有多位队员时，遭到伏击的概率会大幅降低。

column1: It's also generally wise to try to sleep in friendly places, but you might need to obtain permission.
column2: 通常最好在友善的地方睡觉，但可能需要先取得许可。

column2: 请牢记，同一时间每格只能有一个生物站立。如果角色下方出现棕色倒三角，移动速度就会很慢；只要能够站起，就应该尝试起身。点击图示按钮，或按{k}，即可在站立和俯卧之间切换。

column1: You can set your gait/speed and other movement options by clicking the indicated button or pressing {k} . This menu will also show you how stealthfully you are moving.
column2: 点击图示按钮，或按{k}，可设置步态、速度及其他移动选项。该菜单也会显示你目前的潜行程度。

column1: If you have a number pad, you can move one tile at a time by pressing {k} etc. If you want to move carefully, confirming your selection, you can press {k} etc.When flying, use {k} etc. and{k} etc. to change altitude. You can also flying to other altitudes by left/right clicking while the camera is adjusted.
column2: 如果有数字小键盘，可以按{k1}等方向键逐格移动。若想谨慎移动，在行动前确认目标，可以按{k2}等键。飞行时，使用{k3}等键以及{k4}等键来改变高度。调整视角高度后，也可以左键或右键点击，飞往其他高度层。

column1: You can click the indicated button or press {k} to view your character's status. This can be used to view your injuries, skills and needs.
column2: 你可以点击图示按钮，或按{k}查看角色状态，包括伤势、技能和需求。

column1: You can click the indicated button or press {k} to view your log. Your character generally starts with a variety of local knowledge, including a few places to have an adventure. You can also speak to locals and inquire about their troubles.
column2: 你可以点击图示按钮，或按{k}查看日志。角色通常一开始就掌握不少本地知识，其中包括一些适合冒险的地点。你也可以与当地人交谈，询问他们的烦恼。

column1: You can click the indicated button or press {k} to view and interact with your worn and carried items.
column2: 你可以点击图示按钮，或按{k}查看并操作身上穿戴或携带的物品。

column1: You can click the indicated button or press {k} to interact with nearby objects and environmental features. In particular, this is an easy way to pick things up.
column2: 你可以点击图示按钮，或按{k}与附近物体和环境设施交互。这也是拾取物品的便捷方式。

column1: Right click on people to initiate conversations. You can click the indicated button or press {k} to continue an active conversation. People can share troubles they'd like your help with, and you can also trade with shopkeepers or barter with most others.
column2: 右键点击人物可开始交谈。点击图示按钮，或按{k}继续当前对话。人们会讲述希望你帮助解决的烦恼；你也可以与店主交易，或与大多数其他人以物易物。

column1: You can click the indicated button or press {k} to butcher a carcass or to engage in crafting activities. Hunting is an important way to get food. The base game has limited crafting.
column2: 你可以点击图示按钮，或按{k}屠宰尸体或进行制作。狩猎是重要的食物来源，原版游戏的制作内容则较为有限。

column1: You can click the indicated button or press {k} to yield in combat. If the conflict has not reached a No Quarter state, your opponent should stand down. You can also demand your opponent yield using a conversation option.
column2: 你可以点击图示按钮，或按{k}在战斗中投降。只要冲突尚未进入“不留活口”状态，对手通常就会停止攻击。你也可以通过交谈选项，要求对方投降。

column1: You can click the indicated button or press {k} to draw or strap your weapon. If your weapons are drawn and you aren't a local soldier, people may panic.
column2: 你可以点击图示按钮，或按{k}拔出或收起武器。如果你并非当地士兵，亮出武器可能引起恐慌。

column1: If you miss an announcement or would like to review old messages, you can click the indicated button or press {k} to view the message log.
column2: 若错过公告或想回看之前的消息，可以点击图示按钮，或按{k}查看消息记录。

column1: This is the projectile aiming menu. You can shoot projectiles with a launcher like a bow or crossbow, and you can throw almost any object that you are carrying in a grasp. You can initiate throwing from the inventory menu, or by pressing {k} from play.
column2: 这是远程瞄准菜单。可以用弓、弩等发射器射击，也可以投掷手中拿着的几乎任何物品。可以从物品栏菜单发起投掷，也可以在游戏中直接按{k}。

column1: You can stop traveling using the stop travel button below or by pressing .{k} .
column2: 点击下方的停止旅行按钮，或按{k}，即可停止旅行。
